reviews.review_title: Reasons why this game is good
reviews.review_description:
I have a lot of reasons why this game is so fun and good for everyone.

I liked how t-mods, mods, head mod, admins, devs, and owner, treating people like they are very welcomed. It's like you belong in this game.

the cc's are the nicest here, they will show and probable teach. They would let you take screen shots with them if you ask, and record a video together.

this game is also not a copy of gorilla tag or other games, they have their own texture and assets.

and the devs aka managers are the best, like crimson or sage. They both are so goated and the reason to get the game or join the discord.

and of course the owner. Might be the greatest owner I've ever seen tbh. He is always active ingame and discord, and he is very helpful to other people if they don't know what they're doing. He will allow you to do anything but not breaking the rules or asking cosmetics.
He will be friendly if you see him or become funny.

And my favourite person. Hyper. If you see him he will allow you to screen shot or record with him. But he is always busy and calm,
If you're lucky finding him couldsider yourself. If your friends are with him it won't be hard finding him. Hyper might be the best Admin and CC, cause of how friendly he is to his fans or people that doesn't know him. 

And I'm saying every staff and manager and owner are the best.

if you're asking why this long review. To let you know this game was designed to be perfect and very welcoming for new players or og's.

Welp cya because it's verz. Hope you're having the best time playing this game😊
